installCommand: curl -fsSL https://get.pnpm.io/install.sh | env PNPM_VERSION=9.15.4 SHELL=bash sh - && export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/pnpm:$PATH" && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/pnpm:$PATH" && pnpm --filter @angelsnest/api build && mkdir -p public && printf "import 'express';\nexport { default } from '../apps/api/dist/apps/api/src/index.js';\n" > public/index.js
